title.narrative: Strategic Communication to Promote Human Rights, Socio-Environmental Justice, and Good Living

description.narrative:
This project seeks to raise awareness of the geostrategic and political importance of the Pan-Amazon region in terms of water, biodiversity, natural resources, cultures, communities and peoples, the defence of rights, socio-environmental justice and good living.
To this end, it proposes the development and consolidation of mechanisms for discernment and coordination that promote strategic and comprehensive communication aimed at highlighting the realities, contexts, initiatives, proposals and commitments of the peoples and communities around the central theme of water, the geopolitical, ecological and sociocultural potential of the territory, as well as to highlight and promote the traditional knowledge and wisdom of indigenous peoples and traditional communities, their struggles and experiences in promoting and defending their rights and socio-environmental justice.
Within this framework, and in line with the progress already made through previous CAFOD-funded projects in training, production and coordination processes in Amazonian communication, the project will promote and complement the construction and consolidation of a common Pan-Amazonian agenda and strategic plan. This agenda will guide narratives, approaches and strategic positions in relation to the territorial reality, integrating the diversity of the territory, based on the voices and experiences of its leaders, into a cohesive narrative with the capacity to influence local, national, regional and international spaces.
